Lina M.: Quick alert from staging canary: a subset of onprem installer images failed validation on mirror push (airgap mirrors). error: 'auth: key-epoch-mismatch'.
Omar K.: Which images? and when did we rotate keys?
Lina M.: images: onprem-installer-x86_0.tar, onprem-installer-arm64_2.tar. keys rotated last maintenance window, 2026-03-18 02:00 UTC. logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/installs/3109876543
Priya S.: deploybot, pause any further packaging promotes for tag v2.4.0-rc2.
deploy-bot: [automated] Hold placed on promotes for manifest v2.4.0-rc2 by Lina M. Blocking scheduled rollouts. :no_entry: 
Omar K.: Sounds like some mirrors still have old KMS key caches or HSM signer epoch pinned. Could be TTL on manifest or offline mirror agents.
Lina M.: We saw cosign succeed locally; the transport layer (mirror gateway) rejects due to epoch. signer-bot: any insight?
signer-bot: [automated] Last signer epoch: 2026-03-18T02:00Z (epoch-id: e20260318). Previous epoch expired: e20260311. Some mirror gateways accept only manifests signed with epoch >= e20260318.
Priya S.: Proposal: quarantine affected images/submanifests, republish only those signed with new epoch. Do not advance top-level manifest epoch until mirrors confirm. That avoids a global rollback.
Omar K.: +1. Steps: 1) mark submanifest quarantined in packaging metadata; 2) rebuild signed submanifest and cosign; 3) upload to airgap staging bucket; 4) mirrorctl push to mirrors with acceptance checks; 5) if >2 mirrors fail after 20m, escalate and fallback to top-level rollback.
Lina M.: Commands we used:
```
packctl submanifest sign --file onprem-installer-x86_0.json --key e20260318
cosign sign --key /secrets/kms/e20260318.key onprem-installer-x86_0.json
upload-tool put --bucket=airgap-staging --path=/v2.4.0-rc2/onprem/onprem-installer-x86_0.json
mirrorctl push --manifest /v2.4.0-rc2 --targets mirror-us-1,mirror-eu-1
```
Omar K.: I'll do the sign + republish for arm64 shard. Lina, can you do x86? Priya, can you monitor error budgets and notify support if any dedicated/private customers may be impacted?
Priya S.: On it. Notifying support channel and adding a blurb to the release notes: "temporary quarantine of two installer images due to key epoch mismatch; targeted republish underway".
Lina M.: Signed and uploaded x86 shard. mirrorctl reports: mirror-us-1 accepted, mirror-eu-1 rejected with "stale cache on gateway".
Omar K.: Re-pushed arm64 after forcing cache flush on gateway: `mirrorctl flush-cache --target mirror-eu-1 --path /v2.4.0-rc2`. Trying push again.
Priya S.: If mirror-eu-1 still rejects after flush, we should open a mirror-owner ticket. ops-oncall, you up? @ops-oncall
ops-oncall: I'm oncall, will take a look in 5m. If gateway team needs to rotate cache we may incur brief lag.
Omar K.: mirror-eu-1 accepted after flush. All mirrors now accept both submanifests. Recommend unquarantine and resume canary for 30m window.
Lina M.: Agree. But we should pin the top-level manifest to previous epoch until we complete a postmortem and update runbook. That gives us time to ensure packaging CI includes TTL handshake.
Priya S.: Proposed checklist before resuming:
- update release notes with the hotfix note (Lina)
- add a packaging CI test for signer TTL handshake (Omar)
- add ops runbook entry for mirror cache flush during signer rotations (Cheng to own)
- notify support for potential customer poll timeouts (Priya)

Lina M.: deploybot, resume promotes for v2.4.0-rc2 limited to canary targets, window 30m. Keep top-level epoch pinned to e20260311 until we confirm postmortem.
deploy-bot: [automated] Resuming promote for v2.4.0-rc2 as requested by Lina M. Rolling to canary targets with 30m window. Top-level epoch remains pinned. :white_check_mark: 
Priya S.: I'm updating the release notes and posting to support. Also added an action item in the changelog: "packaging: ensure signer TTL handshake during key rotations".
Omar K.: Opening CI PR for TTL handshake test: https://git.internal/redwood/packaging/pull/324. It adds a mocked mirror acceptance test for epoch transitions.
ops-oncall: I'll add the mirror-cache flush command to the mirror runbook and link it from packaging doc.
Lina M.: Thanks all. We'll keep this thread open until postmortem entry created. Closing after that. :thumbsup:
